title: Kiritani Haruka — In The Face Of "What I Love"〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: In The Face Of "What I Love"（4★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I found so many things that I still need to work on during practice this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (How I transition into my dance routine in particular. I may want to speed it up and even add a couple more moves...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aha! There you are, Haruka!
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma, Hoshino, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm? You seem awfully happy, Tenma.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... Today might actually be your lucky day, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She apparently found something that you might really like, Kiritani, and she's been saying, I can't wait to tell her! all morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something I might like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! The answer is... The Penguin Cafe!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*...! Th-The Penguin Cafe?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's a cafe that carries tons and tons of cute penguin merch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They don't have real penguins or anything, but it's filled with penguin goods in return!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The picture I saw was pretty incredible too. The menu's even penguin-themed and also really cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Lemme show you, Haruka!
I took a screenshot yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, you're right... It's wall to wall penguin goods!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Told you so!
I knew you'd like it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd normally say that we should go sometime but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been spending more time on band practice, so it's been kinda tough to find a good time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It would've been nice to go together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that's okay! You can still enjoy it by yourself or invite Minori and everybody else, so I hope you'll get a chance to go and have fun there♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Tenma, Hoshino...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll try to find the time to go with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'd also like it we went together sometime too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like that too. Let's go when we all have a day off...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Promise?
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Homework's done and I have some ideas for our stream...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll take a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like I should clean my room sometime too. I've been so busy lately, I haven't really had the chance...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I could even change which penguins I have out and about too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But that penguin cafe... It was so cute...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Penguin plushies alone almost feel like enough, but they had so many other cute penguin-themed things there too...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I... I can't think of a happier place...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The Penguin Cafe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you should take a little break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you don't find some time to relax, I'm afraid that your body won't be able to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku did say that...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I need to work on our stream so that we can get our name out there more first...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just went to Phoenix Wonderland with Minori the other day too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I took down some ideas about fan service when we went to PXL.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'll probably even compliment the idea I just came up with for our stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, break time's over...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll polish up this idea before I go to bed.
